items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: But he wasn't regular at Dreamland. Jimmy preferred that combo of his own. And when I left Dreamland, I joined Jimmy's band. Where was that? That was at Edelweiss.

ctx.x: Where did you play? What were the first jobs you had?
Well, the first jobs I had was Lulee's, Tom Cole's, Jimmy Boyd at Tenth and Walnut. And then I played around all the houses, the pleasure houses.
Did they just use a piano? They didn't have a band? No, just a piano. Just a piano?
